instruction: Enable SSH sftp-only chroot for users
output:
echo -e 'Subsystem sftp internal-sftp
Match Group sftp-only
	ChrootDirectory %h
	ForceCommand internal-sftp
	X11Forwarding no
	AllowTcpForwarding no' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd
